method: OpenStreetMap buildings (each counted once) and road length within 2 km of Toguz-Bulak village, fetched 2026-11-14. Roads are drivable classes clipped to the circle; footpaths are left out. The slide itself is not mapped yet, so this is measured around this point, not around the slide. Counts what is nearby: not a hazard or population estimate, and OpenStreetMap may miss buildings in rural areas.
